title.en: MALACANANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES REQUIRING THE BUREAU OF INTERNAL REVENUE TO FURNISH THE OFFICE OF THE OMBUDSMAN WITH INCOME TAX RETURNS FILED

text.en:
Provision of Income Tax Returns. - Upon a request duly issued by
the Office of the Ombudsman, the Bureau of Internal Revenue shall expeditiously
furnish the former with certified copies of the Income Tax Returns (ITs) of persons,
natural and juridical, named in said request and for the years specified in the said
PGMA Hologram * 23027

Request; Formalities. - The request shall be issued by the
Ombudsman or his duly authorized representative pursuant to the conduct of the
investigation of public officials, whether currently employed by the Government or
already separated, for graft and corruption, plunder or accumulation of ill-gotten wealth,
in regard to which investigation the request has been made.
The request shall contain a certification that the public official whose IT is
requested is under investigation for graft and corruption, plunder or accumulation of ill-
gotten wealth, specifying therein the title and the docket number thereof. In cases
where the ITs of private natural and juridical persons are also requested, other than
those of the members of the immediate family of the public officer being investigated
and his relatives within the fourth degree of consanguinity or affinity, the request shall
contain an explanation as to its relevance or connection to the investigation.

Use and Confidentiality. - The ITs herein furnished by the Bureau
of Internal Revenue shall remain confidential and shall be used by the Office of the
Ombudsman solely in connection with its investigation for graft and corruption, plunder,
accumulation of ill-gotten wealth cases and other graft-related cases. No information
from the said ITs may be released to the public at any time during or after the
conclusion of the proceedings, except insofar as the same forms part of any order,
resolution or decision rendered in the cases of graft and corruption, plunder,
accumulation of ill-gotten wealth, or as evidence in court or any other proceeding within
the jurisdiction of the Office of the Ombudsman.

Separability Clause. - If any provision or section hereof, or any part
thereof, is declared invalid or unconstitutional, the other subsisting provisions, sections
or parts thereof shall remain valid and effective.

Effectivity. - This Executive Order shall take effect within fifteen
(15) days from its publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 25th day of November
our Lord, Two Thousand and Three.
, in the year of

By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
